title: Paolo Bulgari, Heir of Italian Jewelry Dynasty, Dies at 89
summary_full: As the chairman of his family’s company, Mr. Bulgari embraced maximalist aesthetics that recalled ancient Rome. After the 2008 financial crisis, he steered the sale of the business to LVMH.
